description: Establish a trustworthy measurement environment and capture the before-baseline for the rotation-heavy reports. Without poppler + the licensed Arial/Times faces, tools/compare.py cannot produce metrics comparable to the committed results, so this must run first. Network is OPEN in this sandbox and `make setup` completes fully (verified). This feature does not change reproduction code; it makes the environment green and records numbers to prove improvement later.
steps: Run `uv sync` (or let `uv run` sync) so the venv exists with pymupdf, pillow, scikit-image, scipy, numpy, lxml, jinja2, pyyaml.

Run `bash scripts/setup-environment.sh` (== `make setup`) to install poppler-utils, liberation-sans/serif fonts, cabextract, and download+extract Arial/Times corefonts into /usr/share/fonts/msttcore, then fc-cache. This uses dnf + curl to sourceforge and succeeds under the open network.

Run `uv run python -m tools.doctor` (== `make doctor`) and confirm it prints 'environment ready: measurements are comparable to the committed results' with [ok] for pdftoppm, agent-browser, and all 7 licensed faces.
Run `uv run pytest` (== `make test`) and confirm the existing suite is green against the committed outputs, establishing the baseline test state.

Record a before-baseline: for each of secondary council_schools_rank, region_schools_rank_overall, region_schools_rank_government, and primary council_school_rank_ufaulu_alama, region_shule_nafasi_jumla, read output/<level>/<key-with-dashes>/report.json and note the summary fields (worst_ssim, worst_pixel_delta_percent, worst_text_drift_pt, worst_column_drift_pt, pages_passing/pages_total). Write these numbers into the feature's `findings` field so FEAT-002 can show the delta.
Do NOT modify any file under corpus/. Do NOT relax thresholds anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: `uv run python -m tools.doctor` exits 0 and prints 'environment ready'.
`uv run pytest` runs to completion (green) against the committed outputs.
The feature's findings field contains the recorded before-baseline summary numbers for the five named reports.

environment.setup_script: bash scripts/setup-environment.sh -> 'environment ready'. poppler 24.08.0 already installed, liberation-sans/serif + cabextract present, Arial/Times already in /usr/share/fonts/msttcore (fc-match resolves arial.ttf/arialbd.ttf/times.ttf).
environment.doctor: uv run python -m tools.doctor -> exit 0, 'environment ready: measurements are comparable to the committed results'. All binaries ([ok] pdftoppm 24.08.0, [ok] agent-browser at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin/agent-browser) and all 7 licensed faces [ok].
environment.pytest: uv run pytest -> 654 passed, 46 skipped in ~12s (green against committed outputs). The 46 skips are the per-report done-gate tests that skip while status=wip.
environment.network_mode: OPEN (setup completed; no external fetch needed since fonts/poppler already present).

findings.note: This chore made NO code changes. It only verified env readiness and recorded the before-baseline from the committed output/<level>/<key>/report.json summary blocks below. All five reports are status=wip with 0 pages passing; text_content_equal=true throughout.
